confirmed_bug: Native reverse gear was inferred from time-scaled speed < -0.01 m/s. Near-zero scale or zero polynomial speed loses discrete reverse direction; nominal guidance commands rotation instead of reverse translation.
reproduction: Actual NativeReferenceAdapter and WholeBodyMPPI with current YAML limits, constant reverse native polynomial and analytic clear collision geometry. No ROS or hardware access.
fix: Capture validated native.gears[current_block] under reference lock and pass separately to navigation plan and both proposal stages. guide accepts the same optional direction. Legacy callers and standby retain original behavior.
preserved: paused phase still holds its current pose instead of following the remaining curve
collision, braking, execution, source-age and reference-revision acceptance unchanged
random generation, dynamics, speed caps and deadlines unchanged

native_search_findings.reverse_allowed: real_speed.yaml:100 allow_reverse=true; kino_astar.cpp:124 Reeds-Shepp; :576 negative arc expansion; :524 singular start enables both directions.
native_search_findings.preference: remani_planner_param.yaml:5-7 forward cost 1, reverse cost 3, gear switch cost 10. A native forward detour is possible; this is distinct from losing a published reverse gear.
native_search_findings.retry_budget: real_speed.yaml:82-87 rear distant goal 3 tries per round, 3 failed rounds, shared 3 s round wall budget; generic defaults remani_planner_param.yaml:119-120 5 tries/5 rounds. Current failure has no confirmed trace showing retry exhaustion.
native_search_findings.gear_transport: FSM publishes original singul at remani_replan_fsm.cpp:2194; native_reference.py preserves message singul in gears. Proven loss was in MPPI speed threshold, after sampling/scaling.

limitations: This isolated reproduction establishes a deterministic defect, not that every observed rear-goal stop or replan has this cause. No new hardware validation performed; restart is required for edited Python to load.
